card.name: Discofox
card.tagline: Popular German social partner dance to disco/Schlager.
card.profile: Discofox is a social partner dance that evolved in Europe in the mid-1970s as a rediscovery of the closed dance hold within the otherwise solo-dominated disco scene, roughly contemporaneous with the American hustle. The beginner's basic step is 'step-step-tap' (advanced dancers split-beat a four-step basic over three beats of music). It is danced to 2/4 or 4/4 music - 1970s disco, Eurodisco, Italo disco, pop, techno and Schlager - and is hugely popular at parties, weddings and dance schools in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (English Wikipedia; Danceflavors).
card.insight: Its spread was greatly boosted by the 1977 film 'Saturday Night Fever'; it remains a staple of German Schlager party culture (English Wikipedia).
